collegeFullAddress: Alandi Road, Dighi Hills, Pune, Maharashtra 411015
collegeInfo: Army Institute of Technology (AIT), Pune is exclusive for the wards of Army personnel and is one of India’s top private engineering institutes. AIT offers quality technical education, an active student life, robust placement records, and state-of-the-art infrastructure in a secure, lush campus setting.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Children of ex-/serving Army personnel with merit in academics and family income norms.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Apply online at KSB portal and through AIT admin.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: For reserved and economically weak students domiciled in Maharashtra.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Apply via MahaDBT portal and with AIT verification.

scholarships.scholarshipName: Other Army, Regimental, and Private Scholarships
scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Varying eligibility (branch, academic performance, service background)
scholarships.applicationProcess: Apply as per notification each academic year.

events.eventFullDescription: Aarohan is AIT’s annual flagship technical festival featuring coding contests, robotics, hackathons, quizzes, technical presentations, and workshops, drawing students from all over India.
PULSE is the annual inter-college cultural fest of AIT, featuring dance, music, drama, fashion shows, literary events, and star nights, fostering camaraderie and creativity.
Freshers' and Farewell events at AIT welcome new batches and celebrate graduating students with talent rounds, fun games, awards, and performances.
AIT’s entrepreneurship cell hosts E-Summit and in-house Hackathons for budding innovators, start-ups, and student entrepreneurs in collaboration with industry mentors.

importantDates.event: B.E. Admissions 2024 (via JEE Main & DTE CAP)

infrastructure.infraDescription: AIT Pune’s 50-acre campus includes smart classrooms, state-of-the-art labs, large digital library, computing center, auditorium, sports grounds, modern hostels, mess, gym, health center, Wi-Fi, and a strong student innovation culture with multiple technical and cultural clubs.
